#!/bin/sh
# Probe: PyYAML present, and how the base's gov answers on a bare temporary project.
set -u
python3 -c "import yaml; print('yaml', yaml.__version__)"
P=/tmp/gov-os-lead-W2-104/w2104-probe
rm -rf "$P"
mkdir -p "$P/proj"
git -C "$P/proj" init -q -b main
cd "$P/proj"
PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-104-tests/src python3 -m gov.cli.main skilleval skills/x --json --root "$P/proj"
echo "exit=$?"
PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-104-tests/src python3 -m gov.cli.main accept --help | head -3
echo "exit=$?"
PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-104-tests/src python3 -m gov.cli.main --help | head -12
cd /
rm -rf "$P"
